name: @casoon/lightweight-pdf
description: Render PDFs from a JSON document/template in WASM — no native dependencies, runs in Node.js and edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, ...).

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ../../crates/lightweight-pdf --target web --out-dir ../../bindings/js/pkg -- --no-default-features --features wasm,default-fonts,compress && wasm-opt -Oz --enable-bulk-memory --enable-multivalue --enable-mutable-globals --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-reference-types --enable-sign-ext pkg/lightweight_pdf_bg.wasm -o pkg/lightweight_pdf_bg.wasm && rm -f pkg/.gitignore
scripts.build:schema: cargo run -p lightweight-pdf-cli -- schema > schema.json && json2ts schema.json --additionalProperties false -o src/document.d.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:schema && npm run build:ts
